successCriteria.description: Create src/shared/types/leave.types.ts exporting exactly seven TypeScript string enums: LeaveType (ANNUAL, SICK, MATERNITY, PATERNITY, UNPAID, OTHER), LeaveStatus (PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED), LeaveBalanceStatus (ACTIVE, EXHAUSTED, EXPIRED), EmploymentStatus (ACTIVE, TERMINATED, ON_LEAVE), NotificationType (LEAVE_REQUEST_CREATED, LEAVE_REQUEST_APPROVED, LEAVE_REQUEST_REJECTED, LEAVE_REQUEST_CANCELLED, LEAVE_BALANCE_LOW, LEAVE_BALANCE_EXPIRING), AuditAction (CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE), EntityType (LEAVE_REQUEST, LEAVE_BALANCE, LEAVE_POLICY, EMPLOYEE, NOTIFICATION).
The file src/shared/types/leave.types.ts must have zero imports from other project files (zero project dependencies).
Create tests/unit/shared/types/leave.types.test.ts with Jest unit tests that verify each of the seven enums has exactly the correct member names and string values.
All enum member values must match their keys exactly (TypeScript string enum default behavior), e.g., LeaveType.ANNUAL === 'ANNUAL'.

constraints: The file src/shared/types/leave.types.ts must have zero imports from other project files — it is a leaf dependency with no project-internal dependencies.
All TypeScript code must comply with strict mode: no implicit any, strict null checks enabled.
No usage of the `any` type — use `unknown` with type guards if needed (per HARNESS.json constraint no-any).
Jest unit tests must be placed at tests/unit/shared/types/leave.types.test.ts and must pass with `npx jest`.
